goals.title: Finish the Jenkins to Prefect migration
goals.detail: Permissions cleared Oct 5; the three job migrations and snapshot sync closed Oct 21, closing the epic. Teardown and nonprod bucket carry.

goals.title: Fix file download and IndexD access
goals.detail: HTML-instead-of-file bug closed Oct 5; View in Browser fixed Oct 21. Env vars now use IndexD; JBrowse CORS policy updated.

goals.title: Meet the security remediation dates
goals.detail: High Tomcat CVE closed Oct 5, ahead of Oct 14. Interop GraphQL fix (Medium) is back In Progress, past its Oct 16 date.

goals.title: Ship the News and Announcements pages
goals.detail: Homepage Announcements closed Oct 5. News page build and Publications design are in review for a second sprint.

goals.title: Human Relevance, C3DC interop and DMN
goals.detail: C3DC prototype and DMN example-file sync in review; investigator review In Progress. 2022 DMN sidebar story cancelled.

points.title: Tasks: 9 of 28 closed, 19 pts
points.detail: The Prefect migration (4 tasks, 18 pts), Dev GraphQL introspection, the High Tomcat CVE, and three infrastructure changes: IndexD variables, JBrowse CORS and snapshot sync.

points.title: User stories: 2 of 3 closed
points.detail: Homepage Announcements shipped (3 pts). The 2022 DMN sidebar story (5 pts) was cancelled. DMN example-file sync is in review.

points.title: Bugs: 2 of 2 closed
points.detail: Both production file download bugs flagged HIGH at the Sprint 50 review are fixed.

points.title: Epics: migration epic closed
points.detail: ICDC Jenkins to Prefect Migration closed. The COTC021 v.3 and COTC022 v.3 submission epics carry.

team.shoutout: Charles Ngu built the Prefect migration end to end: worker permissions, all three job migrations and the epic. Michael Fleming fixed View in Browser and delivered the IndexD environment variables, JBrowse CORS policy, snapshot bucket sync and Dev GraphQL introspection. Eric Miller fixed the Critical file download bug, Ambar Rana landed the High Tomcat CVE ahead of its date, Toyo Udosen shipped the Homepage Announcements, and Valentina Epishina held the QA gate.
team.creditNote: Credit comes from the Jira Developer field (customfield_23650): the person who did the work. The Assignee is usually whoever moved the ticket to Closed, often QA, so it is not charted. A ticket with two developers counts for each; coordination work such as IndexD registration has no Developer by design.

risks.title: Interop GraphQL fix is past its date
risks.detail: ICDC-4213 (Medium) had an Oct 16 remediation date and moved back to In Progress. ICDC-4255 (Critical) is also In Progress. Both are with Charles and still need Stage and Production deploys through a ServiceNow change request.
risks.nextStep: Charles and Ambar give a Production date today; Gina tells NCI Security if it lands after Oct 30.

risks.title: The review queue is aging, not just long
risks.detail: 11 of 22 carry-overs are Ready for Review and 9 are there for a second sprint: News page, Publications design, the C3DC prototype, DMN example files and three study close-outs. ICDC-4184 has waited since July.
risks.nextStep: decide today: a named reviewer and review-by date for each, starting with 4242 for the Sprint 53 C3DC goal.

risks.title: COTC021/022 v.3 close-out, third sprint
risks.detail: The indexing and loading tickets (4193, 4194, 4195) and both submission epics remain open while study details are finalized.
risks.nextStep: Philip sets a close-out date so the five close as a batch in Sprint 53.

risks.title: Sprint 53 is 66% inherited
risks.detail: 21 of its 32 tickets carried from Sprint 52, and the sprint commits to a static C3DC interop MVP plus the October monthly release.
risks.nextStep: at the Sprint 53 midpoint, confirm the MVP and release still fit; move 4188 or 4257 out if not.

retro.timingNote: Sprint 53 started yesterday, October 22, with the static C3DC interop MVP and the October monthly release as its goal. Action items from today either get folded into Sprint 53 now or deferred to Sprint 54 planning. Decide which as we assign each one.
retro.liked: The Jenkins to Prefect migration finally closed and both file download bugs are fixed. Say what made that work.
retro.lacked: Nine tickets sat in review for a second sprint and the interop GraphQL fix slipped past its date. Name the real cause.
retro.learned: Anything about finishing a long migration, moving work through review, or how a security fix gets from scan to Production.
